about: English names for Knesset factions whose Hebrew name (Knesset database, KNS_Faction) matches no list or registered party in this repository. Used to show factions in English on MK history cards (scripts/mk-history-runtime.ts) and in generated research-event summaries (scripts/research/build-faction-events.py). Exact Hebrew-name entries take precedence in research summaries so joint factions retain all named components. The party's established English name or abbreviation where one is in common use (Hadash, Ta'al, Mapam, Rafi, Rakah, Gahal, Shinui), else a plain translation or transliteration of the Hebrew name. Display names, not facts: the Hebrew name stays authoritative and is what the card shows in Hebrew. To be checked in the Hebrew/English naming review.

names.יהדות התורה ­ אגודת ישראל ודתיים בלתי מפ: Torah Judaism–Agudat Yisrael and Non-Partisan Religious
names.המחנה התורתי ­ פועלי אגודת ישראל ודתיים: Torah Camp–Poalei Agudat Yisrael and Non-Partisan Religious

sameNameAbout: One English name for factions whose Hebrew name in the Knesset database is exactly the key, in every Knesset (audit cx-factions-07, 12 Nov 2026). Without it the name follows each election's list label, so the same Hebrew name showed as "UTJ" in the 13th to 15th Knessets and "United Torah Judaism" in the 20th, 21st and 25th, and the 23rd Knesset's הבית היהודי as "The Jewish Home" beside "Jewish Home" in every other Knesset. Overrides every other naming rule for these factions; the Hebrew shown is unchanged.
